spans.s:
havanī, f. sacrificial ladle. [prop. fem.
of a substantival nomen agentis, havana,
√hu, 1150d, ‘the sacrificing’ instrument.]

havíṣmant, a. having an oblation; as m.
offerer. [havís, 1235.]

havís, n. oblation, which, as gift for the
gods, is offered wholly or partly in the
fire; generally, grain (parched, boiled, as
porridge, or as baked cake), milk in
divers forms, fat, and--best of all--
Soma. [√hu, 1153.]

havya-váh [403], a. carrying the offering
(to the gods); as m. oblation-bearer
(used of Agni), selections lvi., lxvi.
